BOOK ONE · LESSON 066

What's the time?

几点了？

A bilingual lesson about telling the time (o'clock, quarter, half past) and asking about birthdays and ages, with 12 numbered clocks, a July calendar and four 'enjoy' pictures. Includes workbook preposition, situation and personal-answer practice, plus grammar on dates, alternative time-telling and at/in/on. 关于报时（整点、一刻、半点）以及询问生日和年龄的双语课，配12幅编号时钟、7月日历和4幅 enjoy 插图。配合教材介词、情景和自答练习，以及日期、另一种报时方式和 at/in/on 的语法练习。
